Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 56, verses 1–3:

Naming of the Surah

• It is called al-Waqi'ah (the Inevitable Event), because it opens with al-Waqi'ah, which is the Resurrection. The surah is filled with mention of the events of that Day and its severe terrors.

From the Objectives of the Surah

• Reminding of the Day of Resurrection and affirming that it will certainly occur, describing what befalls this earthly world at the hour of the Resurrection, mentioning the attributes of the people of Paradise and their bliss, and mentioning the punishment of the people of Hellfire.

• Establishing the gathering (al-hashr) and recompense, and providing evidence for God's power to bring creation back again through what He originated of existing things after they were not.

• Affirming that the Qur'an is sent down from God, and that it is a blessing which God has bestowed upon people.

[The Tafsir]

When the Resurrection comes to pass, there will be no one to deny its occurrence. It will bring low the enemies of God into the Fire, and raise up His friends into Paradise.
